scope: Define which curriculum lane families may later consume the four approved semantic source lanes, without assigning any of the 139 slots, authoring HNK payload, or inferring grammar.

architecture_routes.name: LEXICAL_AND_TEACHER_SOURCE_REVIEW
architecture_routes.boundary: Eligibility does not assign a vocabulary or teacher-note slot. Exact glosses and authority labels remain unchanged; SARU remains evidence for every day/habituality, not usually.

architecture_routes.name: INTERACTION_PATTERN_HOLD
architecture_routes.boundary: No question, answer, predicate, locative or modal frame may be inherited or authored from lexical relevance alone.

architecture_routes.name: STRUCTURE_PATTERN_HOLD
architecture_routes.boundary: The target I usually... remains unresolved in HNK; SARU does not fill it and no habitual/frequency/aspect grammar is established.

architecture_routes.name: DERIVED_CONTENT_HOLD
architecture_routes.boundary: Story, activation and review content must derive only from separately governed L03 payloads; this architecture creates none.
